acceptanceCriteria: The cause of 'descendant did not start' at 0.17s is identified
TestVerificationCancellationCleansDescendant only accepts a complete, parsed, nonzero pid (for example, keep polling while the read is empty or Atoi fails), or the fixture writes the pid atomically
The test passes repeatedly under load (for example -count=50 alongside parallel packages)
body:
## Observation

CI go-product-shard (1) on PR #525 (head ddc47ed0, run 37211690574, job 111466247269, 2026-10-04) failed `internal/localcompletion` TestVerificationCancellationCleansDescendant with `lifecycle_unix_test.go:96: descendant did not start` after only 0.17s. The PR does not touch internal/localcompletion, and shards 0, 2 and 3 passed.

## Suspected cause (hypothesis, not confirmed)

The test polls `.git/descendant.pid` for up to 3s, but breaks on the first successful `os.ReadFile` and ignores the `strconv.Atoi` error. The fixture writes the file with `sh -c 'sleep 30 & echo $! > .git/descendant.pid; wait'`. The redirection creates or truncates the file before echo writes it, so a read in that window gets empty content, pid stays 0, and the test fails at once rather than waiting out the deadline. The 0.17s failure time fits this: it is far short of the 3s deadline.

Expected: the test waits for a complete pid. Actual: an empty read ends the wait early.
title: localcompletion: TestVerificationCancellationCleansDescendant fails early on an empty pid-file read
